dataSources.name: Fictional cloud vendor dataset
dataSources.note: Invented vendors and illustrative pricing; no real quotes. Prepared as three CSV sources under data/ (quotes, egress rates, support and SLA terms) for Zetaris registration.

knownLimitations: Coordinator plus three specialists in a planned sequence plus an evaluator verification pass; not a free-form swarm. Core reasoning is deterministic; models only draft Why answers (verified against the cited receipts before display) and critique the synthesis inside the evaluator receipt. Payments are simulated in mock mode, the default; live mode signs EIP-3009 authorizations on Base Sepolia without submitting them. Vendor data is fictional. The Zetaris data-layer wiring is implemented in the pipeline and verified against a local stub endpoint; the live AWS cluster test is pending, and the Meterless live endpoint test is pending the event API key.

components: x402 payment gateway (mock mode default, live EIP-3009 signing on Base Sepolia)
Hash-chained receipt store (sha256, tamper verification, itemized bill)
Coordinator and specialist agent pipeline (seven paid steps, challenge re-execution, chaos recovery, Why box with citations)
Fictional vendor dataset (Nimbus Cloud, Stratus Systems, Cirrus Compute; synthetic, labeled)
preExistingCode.declared: TBD: declaration text drafted in SUBMISSION_CHECKLIST.md; submitted via the HackOS form at freeze

sampleMode.behavior: Documented offline mode. With SAMPLE_MODE=true the server makes no external network calls at all: model providers are refused even when keys are set, and reasoning, Why answers, and evaluator checks run on the deterministic path over the bundled labeled sample dataset. Health and run payloads disclose sampleMode: true and the UI shows a SAMPLE MODE banner. Default mode runs the same agent logic with the model path enabled when a provider is configured.

cursor.role: Development environment: this repo was developed and smoke-tested in the Cursor IDE with its Agent.
cursor.sitsIn: Development environment of record on the team laptop

meterless.enginesUsed: None. Meterless is used as the Nemotron provider runtime; no named Meterless engine (H-MEM, World Model, Markovian, Scout Intent) is claimed.
meterless.role: Model access layer at run time. A provider chain in src/agents.ts calls Meterless first when METERLESS_BASE_URL and METERLESS_API_KEY are set (OpenAI-compatible endpoint, Bearer key, NVIDIA Nemotron as the model), with OpenRouter as the fallback.
meterless.sitsIn: Model seam in src/agents.ts and src/why.ts: evaluator critique and Why box drafts
meterless.status: Provider chain implemented and verified against a local stub endpoint; live endpoint test pending the event API key

nvidia.models: nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b (primary; default NEMOTRON_MODEL on the Meterless path); on the OpenRouter fallback path, nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free then nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free
nvidia.role: Nemotron models draft Why answers (verified against the cited receipts before being shown) and critique the synthesis inside the evaluator receipt. Every model result records the provider and the exact model id that answered.
nvidia.sitsIn: Model seam in src/agents.ts and src/why.ts, reached through the provider chain
nvidia.status: Wired through the provider chain; live run pending the Meterless event API key

zetaris.role: Data layer. The vendor dataset is three sources (quotes, egress rates, support and SLA terms) bundled as CSV files under data/ for registration in Zetaris. The pipeline's data steps fetch through src/zetaris.ts: live SQL against the instance when ZETARIS_BASE_URL is configured (receipts record query, rows, and dataSource "zetaris"), and the bundled CSV sources otherwise (dataSource "csv-fallback").
zetaris.sitsIn: src/zetaris.ts data layer and the data steps in src/agents.ts; receipts record the query and rows
zetaris.status: Wiring implemented in the pipeline and verified against a local stub endpoint; live test against the managed AWS cluster pending

tagline: Pay-per-thought agent network where the why is the receipt chain
